mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID prodId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, RPI2.PROD_RE regCode, RPI.SET_DATE setDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 P_PROD_ID:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{PRODID} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(OPEN_START_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') openStartDate ,TO_CHAR(OPEN_END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') openEndDate ,TO_CHAR(OPERATION_START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') operationStartDate ,TO_CHAR(AUTO_REDEEM_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') autoRedeemDate ,TO_CHAR(HOLD_DAYS) holdDays FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE > TO_DATE(#{announceDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') WHERE INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.OPERATION_START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') operationStartDate, TO_CHAR(T.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') autoRedeemDate, TO_CHAR(HOLD_DAYS) holdDays, /*超额业绩报酬*/ ABOVE_AMT aboveAmt, /*超额业绩报酬-确认金额*/ NVL(T2.AFFIRM_AMT,0) affirmAmt, /*超额业绩报酬-确认份额*/ NVL(T2.AFFIRM_NUM,0) affirmNum FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{announceDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') /* 查询根据自动赎回日查询超额业绩报酬 */ LEFT JOIN REP_FLOAT_FEE RFF ON RFF.status = 'E' AND RFF.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE = RFF.AFFIRM_DATE where INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE desc
